offering_description.value: Ashland sells pharmaceutical excipients, personal care ingredients, specialty additives and chemical intermediates to manufacturers. It develops and manufactures these materials for use in products such as medicines, shampoos, coatings and construction materials.

primary_products.value: pharmaceutical excipients; personal care ingredients; cellulose-based thickeners; coatings and construction additives; butanediol and its derivatives

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical, personal care, coatings, construction materials and industrial chemical manufacturers

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; personal care; paints and coatings; construction materials; industrial chemicals

revenue_model.value: product sales: Formulation ingredients, performance additives and chemical intermediates

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes cellulose and chemical feedstocks into ingredients and intermediates for formulators and industrial manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Pharmaceutical excipients, personal care ingredients, specialty additives and chemical intermediates

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Account teams serving manufacturers and formulators; distributors / dealers: Specialty chemical and ingredient distributors serving regional customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chemical manufacturing and sales are subject to environmental, workplace safety and chemical registration rules, including EU REACH.

notes: The current scope of chemical intermediate sales to external customers is uncertain.
